description: Who someone is to the player, said in a sentence or two under their name in the talk box and on their card: the relation from the family records, then where they work or study from their job and school records. Said plainly, as a person would (owner, Oct 27).

slots.relation: The relation word for a kin record (partner, mother, cousin).
slots.employer: The employer's name from the job record, with a trailing company suffix dropped.
slots.title: The job title from the job record.
slots.school: The school from the person's school records.
